title: Company Secretary
description: A Day in Your Life at MKS:We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Company Secretary with approximately 02 years of experience in handling corporate secretarial matters, statutory compliances, and regulatory filings for a private limited company.The candidate will be responsible for ensuring compliance with the Companies Act, 2013, applicable rules and regulations, maintaining statutory records, coordinating Board and General Meetings, supporting management on corporate governance and legal matters, applying for/renewing licenses, drafting & vetting various types of agreements and research work on legal/compliance matters.Key Roles & Responsibilities ROC & Statutory CompliancesEnsure timely compliance with the Companies Act, 2013 and applicable rules. Prepare and file statutory forms with the Registrar of Companies (ROC), including AOC-4, MGT-7, DIR-12, PAS-3, MSME-1, DPT-3 and other applicable forms. Maintain and update statutory registers, records, and other secretarial documents including registers of members, directors, charges, and contracts. Track statutory due dates and ensure timely filing of returns and forms. Handle compliance relating to changes in share capital, directorship, registered office, and other corporate matters. Coordinate with auditors, consultants, and other professionals for statutory and regulatory requirements. Monitor changes in corporate laws and regulatory requirements. Handle documentation relating to appointment, resignation and changes in directors and KMPs. Assist in share transfers, allotments, transmission, and other share capital-related matters. Maintain the company's statutory books and corporate records. Board & General Meeting ManagementCoordinate and organize Board Meetings, Committee Meetings and Annual General Meetings. Prepare notices, agendas, notes to agenda, and minutes of meetings. Ensure compliance with statutory requirements relating to meetings. Maintain minute books and other meeting-related records. Liaison & CoordinationCoordinate with ROC, MCA, statutory auditors, internal teams and external consultants. Assist in internal audit and statutory audit requirements. Provide compliance-related support and documentation to management including taking care of CSR compliances. Maintain proper records of regulatory filings and acknowledgements. Agreement handling and SupportDrafting and vetting of various types of agreementsKeeping track and following up with relevant stakeholders for timely renewal of expiring agreementsHandling, managing and keeping the agreement tool/software updated and supporting stakeholders regarding the agreement tool Research Work and License/Registration managementResearch work on newly notified laws and amendments for reviewing their applicability to the organizationTimely research and reporting on various legal, secretarial and compliance topics to advise managementApplying for various licenses and registrations applicable to the organizationTracking and timely renewal of expiring licenses/registrations and following up with relevant stakeholders for renewalWork as custodian of licenses and registrationsRequired Qualifications & SkillsQualified Company Secretary (ACS) from the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) with approximately 02 years of experience in secretarial and corporate compliance. Candidates possessing LL.B. degree in addition to ACS qualification will be preferred. Good working knowledge of the Companies Act, 2013 and applicable rules. Practical experience in MCA portal filings and ROC compliances. Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint). Strong drafting, communication, coordination, and organizational skills. Ability to manage compliance calendars and statutory deadlines. Knowledge of FEMA and RBI compliances. Sound knowledge of legal compliances and strong legal analytical skills. Experience coordinating with statutory auditors and external legal professionals and consultants. Key CompetenciesAttention to detail and accuracy. Strong ownership and accountability. Effective time management. Good written and verbal communication. Ability to handle multiple compliance deadlines. Professional integrity and confidentiality.

title: Company Secretary
description:
**Location:** 
 Bahadurgarh, Haryana
 



**Experience:** 
 2–5 Years
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
   




 Job Summary
 
 We are looking for a qualified and detail\-oriented
 **Company Secretary (CS)** 
 to manage corporate compliance, statutory filings, legal documentation, and secretarial functions. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of the Companies Act, SEBI regulations, and other applicable statutory requirements.
   




 Key Responsibilities
 * Ensure compliance with the
 **Companies Act, 2013** 
 and applicable rules and regulations.
* Manage ROC filings, statutory registers, and corporate records.
* Prepare notices, agendas, minutes, resolutions, and other Board/General Meeting documents.
* Coordinate and assist in conducting Board Meetings and General Meetings.
* Maintain and update statutory records and registers.
* Handle incorporation, changes in directors, shareholding, and other corporate matters.
* Coordinate with ROC, MCA, auditors, legal advisors, and other regulatory authorities.
* Monitor statutory and regulatory compliance timelines.
* Draft and review corporate agreements, resolutions, notices, and official correspondence.
* Provide support to management on corporate governance and compliance matters.


 Eligibility \& Skills
 * Qualified
 **Company Secretary (CS)** 
 from ICSI.
* Graduate in any discipline; LLB/Commerce background will be an advantage.
* 2–5 years of relevant experience.
* Strong knowledge of Companies Act, MCA/ROC compliances, and corporate governance.
* Good drafting, communication, organizational, and analytical skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office and MCA/ROC portal.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet statutory deadlines.



**Benefits:** 



* Competitive salary based on experience.
* Professional development opportunities.
* Supportive work environment.



  





**To Apply: Send your resume to hr@rajeshwaripetrochem.com** 




  





**Abhilash Shah** 




**HR Manager** 




**Rajeshwari Petrochem Pvt. Ltd.**
